verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers real-time, single-conversation voice agent capabilities (function calling, telephony, multi-agent handoff, reusable configs) but nothing about processing many items/files/sessions in bulk as a batch operation. The dg CLI mention of 'transcribe files' is too thin to establish a bulk-operations capability. missing for 10: batch/bulk transcription or agent-session processing documentation, evidence of parallel/batch job APIs, throughput or queue-based bulk workflows.
